title: Falcon Space Biefeld-Brown vacuum test: rotation reverses as pressure drops

tellings.quote:
they did the tests at not too low
pressure and they noticed it spinning in
one direction and then eventually they
kept pumping down further and further
and eventually it started spinning in
the other direction which

plain: In a test by a group called Falcon Space of the Biefeld-Brown effect, the claim that a high-voltage device can push itself along without a normal exhaust, a device in a sealed chamber spun one way, and then spun the other way as more and more air was pumped out. A researcher named David describes the test without naming a source, and mentions the writer Tim Ventura and a man named Mark in connection with it. The reversal matters because, if the push came only from moving air, it should simply fade in a near vacuum rather than change direction.
